title: How to Survive the Apocalypse | Kiry Shabazz | Stand Up Comedy
description:
In Kiry Shabazz's 3rd Don't Tell Comedy set, he jokes about different tactics one can use to make it through the inevitable apocalypse

Comedy is at its best when there's a surprise – that's why Don't Tell Comedy puts on events where the performers and location are kept secret until the day of the show. With over 200 cities already in on the joke, you never know where we'll set up shop, or who might pop in. Want to be let in on the secret? Visit our website below to find an upcoming show near you: https://www.donttellcomedy.com

Just don't tell anyone!! 🤫

-----------------------------------------------------------

Based in Los Angeles, Kiry Shabazz is an instant crowd favorite. A winner of StandUp NBC and a Just For Laughs Alum, Kiry made his late-night debut on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon and has appeared on Comedy Central, Epix, and Bill Burr Presents: The Ringers.

Kiry recently made his film debut in Good Fortune, directed by Aziz Ansari, following a national commercial directed by Ramy Youssef. With his "Back to Back" Don’t Tell Comedy sets currently viral, Kiry’s social media presence and live audience turnout continue to grow nationwide.
